headline: USMNT's Aaronson inks new 3-year deal with Leeds United

description: Matthias Jaissle told his detractors he does not care about their opinions amid a wave of negativity for his Newcastle side ahead of the start of the new season.

headline: Hull chairman hits out at 'laughable' Joe Cole criticism

headline: Michael Carrick: 'Ridiculous' to say Man United have easy start
description: Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick has hit back at suggestions that Manchester United have been given a favourable start to the Premier League season.
